curatedMovie.curiosityHook: How will Brian’s success behind the bar fit with Doug’s cynical approach to money?
curatedMovie.description: After leaving the Army, Brian Flanagan returns to Queens and lands a bartending gig under Doug Coughlin. Mastering flashy mixology, he quickly wins over crowds while embracing his mentor's cynical pursuit of quick cash.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Breezy and stylish with moderate emotional weight; an easy-watching 1980s romance driven by ambition and nightlife energy.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Roger Donaldson balances high-energy nightlife showmanship with an undercurrent of dramatic ambition, delivering a vibrant blend of crowd-pleasing romance and charm.
